funding.supported_assets_note: Stablecoin-based card; card top-up by credit/debit card costs 3% (min 1 USD). Crypto deposit fees not read.

variants.region_label: Worldwide except a published exclusion list

eligibility.usage_note: Official article (2026-08-28) lists 47 regions where cards are NOT issued (incl. Croatia, Slovenia, Singapore, Turkey, USA, India). No positive list is published, so other countries stay 'to confirm'. ISO mapping is ours (Kosovo→XK, Netherlands Antilles→AN).

kyc.stages_note: Identity verification exists (verification page, Sumsub logo, FAQ about rejected verification) but the stage and documents are not stated on the pages read. Not established as a no-KYC product.

fees.conditions: Virtual card 10 USD; physical card 100 USD; deducted from balance.
Top-up by credit/debit card: 3%, minimum 1 USD. Crypto top-up fee not read.

changelog.reason: Initial record from homepage, card page and three help-centre articles (single read). FX/ATM/limits are in an image on the fees article and still unknown; issuer and network not named; KYC stage not stated.

Second independent read on 2026-10-30 of all six evidence pages (EN versions of the same help-centre articles): every value the record states is confirmed — virtual card 10 USD, physical card 100 USD deducted from balance, 5 USD welcome reward spending-only (article dated 2026-07-27); card top-up 3% min 1 USD, waived under 1 USD (2026-08-28); 'no annual fees' on the card page and 'no card management, monthly, or annual fees' (article 10566233, 2026-07-28); 47 excluded regions identical name for name (2026-08-28), 'cannot be registered as billing addresses', 'global sanctions and card network restrictions'; Apple Pay / Google Pay; 130M+ merchants; 'fintech service provider and not a bank'; issuer and network still unnamed ('leading card networks'); KYC stage still not stated (Verification link, Sumsub logo only). The fees article 10339271 (2026-07-24) still carries every figure inside an image with empty alt text — unreadable, unchanged. NOT published: the validator refuses a published variant whose KYC status is unknown; issuer and network are also unknown. No value changed. New official information found but NOT added by this run (research-run / David): help-centre article 'Can I Withdraw Cash from an ATM' (https://helpcenter.redotpay.com/en/articles/10622095-can-i-withdraw-cash-from-an-atm-and-are-there-any-fees, 2026-07-27) states ATM 2% on USD cards up to 10,000 USD/month then 3% (HKD cards 2%), transactions in another currency 1.2%, crypto conversion 1%, no fee in the card's currency — these would fill the FX and ATM 'unknown' fields after a research read. The homepage footer now shows a regulatory statement: 'Inscripto bajo el N° 144 en el Registro de PSAV de la CNV (República Argentina)' and a Hong Kong Money Lender's Licence No. 1715/2025 — new regulatory statement, for David's attention.

editorial.summary: Stablecoin prepaid card (network and issuer not named) available outside a 47-region exclusion list that includes the US, India, China and Turkey. Virtual card 10 USD, physical 100 USD, no annual fee, 3% fee on card top-ups; FX and ATM fees not readable yet; no cashback documented.
good_for: Residents of countries not served by European issuers who need a stablecoin-funded card
not_for: Residents of the US, India, Turkey, Singapore, Croatia or Slovenia (not issued)
Anyone who wants a named issuer and a readable fee schedule before choosing
watch_outs: Issuer and card network are not disclosed on the pages read.
FX and ATM fees are published only as an image; treated as unknown.
Identity verification stage not stated; this is not established as a no-KYC card.
A 16-year-olds eligibility article exists in the help centre — age rules to verify before any recommendation.
